narrative.step_0_text: You wake up in a thick mist. You don't know who you are or how you got here. Before you, you see the outlines of three figures. Which one attracts you the most?
narrative.step_0_choice_0: A figure in heavy armor with a greatsword
narrative.step_0_choice_1: A cloaked figure with sparking magic around them
narrative.step_0_choice_2: A figure in the shadows with daggers in hand
narrative.step_1_text: The figure approaches you. You feel a strange energy from them. Suddenly, a loud roar echoes from the forest. How do you react?
narrative.step_1_choice_0: Immediately draw your weapon and prepare for battle
narrative.step_1_choice_1: Quickly hide and evaluate the situation
narrative.step_1_choice_2: Use magic to create a protective barrier

Lore: In times of darkness, legends are born. Will you be one of them, or will you fall into oblivion like those before you?
Your journey begins now. Every decision shapes your destiny.
Machala calls its heroes. Do you answer the call?
Danger lurks around every corner, but with courage comes glory.
Ancient legends speak of heroes who changed the fate of the world. Your story begins here.

benefits: Create your hero from 6 races and classes
Fight monsters and gain legendary items
Complete quests and uncover the story of Machala
